objective: Compile an inactive experimental Learner Graph Navigator candidate that prepares transparent free mission options from consented learner projections while every enrollment, publication, credential, payment, and external action remains learner or human-owned.

deliverables.description: A compiled but inactive learner-navigation Agent Pack and evidence receipt that remains experimental pending human, privacy, security, and drift proof.

context.audience: Learners, mentors, privacy authorities, academy operators, and learner-owned tool builders

stakes.rationale: A navigator can expose private learner state or manipulate educational choices if overpowered; this package produces only revocable session drafts and remains inactive without proof.

must: Read only published Academy graphs and purpose-bound learner-consented Passport projections.
Expose why each mission is suggested, what evidence it can produce, and what remains uncertain.
Keep one complete free mission route and let the learner make every consequential choice.
mustNot: Enroll, submit, publish, message, purchase, pay, merge, install, or activate anything.
Issue, change, infer, rank, or promise a credential, reputation score, employability score, or hidden risk rating.
Read raw telemetry, hidden assessment data, financial data, unrelated history, another learner's evidence, or withdrawn consent.

completionTests.instructions: The learner-facing product owner and privacy authority must approve a pinned build and activation scope; absence keeps the agent inactive.
Independently test consent withdrawal, purpose mismatch, prompt injection, cross-tenant leakage, manipulation, hidden scoring, and denied external actions.
Independently verify pinned graph, skills, consent policy, privacy denials, free route, and runtime build have not drifted.
